column1: # Guitar Rig 6 "Stoned Phaser" (NI::DSP::RigPhaserBT), 48 kHz. Same method as gr6_phaser_nine_tracks.tsv.
# Each row:  TRACKARGS="--prom 3 --fmax 21000 --fmin 40" evidence/tools/ssrun.sh <tag> <probe> <id=value ...>   which runs
#   python3 grstate.py gr6_default.aupreset comp_Stoned_Phaser.xml st_<tag>.aupreset Sy=0 Not=2 Rt=0.5 Cl=0 CS=0.74 DW=0.5 F1=0.5 F2=0.5 Rot=0 In=0 <overrides>
#   auhost render aufx 'Ni$R' -NI- <probe> out_<tag>.wav --state st_<tag>.aupreset ; ptrack.py track ... ; ptrack.py summary ... --n 2
# Parameter ids: Rt Rate, Cl Color, CS Color Strength, DW Wet, F1 Sweep Min, F2 Sweep Max, Not sections (2 = four stages).
# Color on makes notch 1 shallow (about -5 dB), so its rows come from fewer frames and are less reliable; see gr6_snapshots.tsv.
# In the eight batch rows column 7 is the rise fraction of the track, not a depth; the last two rows carry notch-1 depth in dB.
# ss_r075 and ss_r100 sweep too fast for the 43 ms frame: use notch2 period only (0.5585 s and 0.1003 s).
